meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂工作拆成多个环节,派给多个助手并行执行并汇总结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务太重,想拆给多个 AI 助手分头做完再统一汇总。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a task is too big to do alone and you want several assistants to split it and report back.

howto.what: Claude 会通过命令行工具协调多个受监督的 Orca worker:传递线程消息、阻塞式 ask/reply、派发任务、等待 worker_done 或升级、编排任务 DAG、设置决策门与协调循环,并把工作拆分给不同 agent。
howto.when: 当你需要结构化的多 agent 协调时接管,比如派发任务、等待 worker 完成、编排任务 DAG 等;单纯的终端控制或完整所有权交接则交给 orca-cli。

say.text: 把这个任务拆给几个 worker,用协调循环推进
say.note: Claude 会按任务 DAG 派发并等待结果

say.text: 给那个 worker 发消息问进度,等它回复再继续
say.note: 走阻塞式 ask/reply 流程

say.text: 等 worker_done,如果它升级就转给我处理
say.note: Claude 会在该等待点挂起

howto.what_en: Claude coordinates supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, waiting on worker_done or escalation, task DAGs, decision gates and coordinator loops, splitting work across agents.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you need structured multi-agent coordination, such as task dispatch, waiting for a worker to finish, or coordinating a task DAG; plain terminal control and full ownership handoffs go to orca-cli.

say_en.text: Split this task across a few workers and drive it with a coordinator loop.
say_en.note: Claude dispatches per the task DAG and waits

say_en.text: Message that worker and ask for status, then wait for its reply.
Wait for worker_done and route any escalation to me.
say_en.note: Claude parks at that wait point
